name: drain-console
description: Watch an issue-drain run from inside Claude Code: a pane with one row per unit, a status line entry, a notification when a unit merges, blocks or parks, a /drain command, and a button that asks the driver to stop after the current unit. It reads the run folder and never merges or changes the run's state.

run_dir.title: Run folder
run_dir.description: The issue-drain run folder to watch, e.g. ~/.issue-drain/owner__repo/2026-11-23-a. Empty watches the run whose state.json changed last.

poll_seconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to read the run folder. Values under 5 use 15.

summarise_on_stop.title: Summarise when the drain needs a person
summarise_on_stop.description: When a unit blocks or parks, or the drain stops or finishes, submit a prompt asking Claude to read the run and propose the next move. Off by default: it starts a model turn.
